description: Return the whole category tree: every category, the groups inside it, object counts, and the catalog version. Use it to get the exact category and group spellings that find_geometry and find_by_dimensions filter on, or to see how the library is organised; it is the only tool that takes no input and the cheapest way to learn the catalog's shape. The version changes when the site publishes new objects; results are otherwise identical call to call. Read-only, no auth.
name: list_categories

categories.description: category name -> { count, groups: { group name -> count } }

version.description: Catalog version; changes when objects are added or revised.

title: List categories and groups with counts
